tools.name: Replit Ghostwriter

ContextAware Suggestions:Ghostwriter understands your code context to give accurate completions.

tools.name: RegexMy
tools.description: RegexMy is a versatile platform offering powerful AI tools designed to streamline search and file operations tasks. It features an AI-powered regex builder, XPath builder, and tools for file summarization, reporting, translation, and code localization. Whether you're looking to enhance productivity or ensure accuracy in your workflow, RegexMy provides advanced features to meet your needs.

tools.name: HyperWrite
tools.description: HyperWrite AI Assistant is an advanced AI-powered writing tool designed to enhance productivity by providing intelligent writing suggestions, content generation, and editing assistance. Built for professionals, students, and content creators, it leverages machine learning to refine writing style, improve clarity, and generate high-quality text efficiently. Whether drafting emails, reports, or creative content, HyperWrite AI Assistant adapts to user preferences to deliver personalized and contextually relevant outputs.

tools.name: WriteHuman
tools.description: WriteHuman is an AI-powered tool designed to humanize AI-generated text, making it undetectable by AI detection tools like GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai. It ensures AI-assisted content maintains a natural, human-like tone while preserving readability and coherence.

tools.name: RooCode
tools.description: Roo Code (formerly Roo Cline) is an open-source, AI-powered development assistant built directly into Visual Studio Code. Acting like a full-stack “AI dev team,” it helps you plan, write, and refactor code across multiple files, run terminal commands, launch browsers, and debug—all from within your editor.

tools.name: Writer
tools.description: Writer is an advanced enterprise platform designed to help businesses quickly build and deploy AI applications and workflows. By integrating generative AI into any business process, Writer enables businesses to create accurate, cost-effective AI solutions that are scalable, customizable, and secure. Writer allows companies to leverage cutting-edge technology, including top-ranked language models and secure platforms, to meet their specific AI requirements.

tools.name: CodeSnaps
tools.description: Codesnaps.io is a React and Tailwind CSS UI Library primarily designed to help developers build websites and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) faster and design more efficiently. Its main purpose is to provide instant access to a vast collection of production-ready React and Tailwind CSS components, alongside an AI site generator, eliminating the need for tedious package installations and accelerating the development workflow.
